svg.text: PRECISE. INDEXED. AN INSTRUMENT MANUAL FOR DEVELOPERS.
Sixteen pads. One readable story. Follow an input
from the surface of the instrument to the screen.
The instrument stays recognizable. Everything that does not
help explain this step recedes into the background.
Put the explanation next to the thing that changes. Use the
same names in the prose, diagram and code example.
SELECT FOR: GUIDES / REFERENCE / LONG TECHNICAL WRITEUPS
